rootCause.finding: Next.js 16 buffers the request body when proxy.ts (middleware) runs, with a default limit of 10MB (experimental.proxyClientMaxBodySize). Any textbook PDF over ~10MB was truncated at the proxy boundary, so request.formData() threw 'Failed to parse body as FormData / expected boundary after body' inside POST /api/admin/subjects/[id]/book. The route had no try/catch around the parse, so Next returned a generic HTTP 500.
rootCause.evidence: Server log: 'Request body exceeded 10MB for /api/admin/subjects/.../book. Only the first 10MB will be available unless configured.' followed by '⨯ TypeError: Failed to parse body as FormData.'

fix.route: app/api/admin/subjects/[id]/book/route.ts: formData() parse wrapped -> Arabic error redirect (too_large when declared length exceeds MAX+1MB, otherwise invalid_file); uploadBook wrapped -> upload_failed; never a 500, admin stays on the book screen
fix.workerDx: package.json worker:index now loads .env.local (--env-file-if-exists) so local indexing works out of the box

indexing.generatedRealPdf: 10-page PDF with a clean embedded Arabic text layer (PyMuPDF installed locally, matching the Docker worker)
indexing.worker: pnpm worker:index -- --once -> READY, 10/10 pages, 10 chunks, 10 page images
indexing.retrieval: multi-token queries hit the correct pages (إكمال المربع -> page 2, القانون العام -> page 3); single-token queries are below the design score threshold
indexing.realAiLesson: POST /api/tutor on the indexed book -> 200, sufficientContext true, 4 segments, source citation page 2 (real OpenAI call)
indexing.pageAccess: admin 200, bundle student 200, math-only student 404, expired trial 404, anonymous 401
